description: This file defines an interface for a dispatcher component within the WPEFramework plugin system, including nested callback interface, method signatures for validation, invocation, revocation, and access to local dispatcher.

classes.name: IDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for dispatching remote procedure calls, with methods for validation, invocation, revocation, and access to local dispatcher.

classes.name: IDispatcher::ICallback
classes.description: Callback interface for handling events, errors, responses, subscriptions, and unsubscriptions related to dispatcher operations.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token for a specific method with given parameters.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method with a callback, channel, and token, returning a response.

methods.name: Local
methods.description: Provides access to the local dispatcher instance.
